name: a real phone screen fills the frame
looks: A headline lands, then the frame holds a real phone mockup: a status bar, the app's own name, a grid of icon tiles and a bottom tab bar, filling almost the whole vertical frame as one honest screenshot.
build: The phone frame and its content are a single fixed DOM panel scaled to fill the 9:16 frame (ui-tilt-card's held-panel mechanic, no tilt); a small trail of dots animates along the tab bar to draw the eye to it.
sound: A soft whoosh as the screen settles into frame.
prompt: Hold a real, honest phone-screen mockup filling almost the whole vertical frame, status bar and all, with a grid of icon tiles and a bottom tab bar, and a small trail animating along the tab bar to draw the eye there.
